name: Uuuh!
summary: UUUH! is a mobile one-on-one mind game based on a traditional hand-clapping game. In each round both players choose an action at the same time without seeing the other's choice, and the choices are revealed together. There are five actions: Charge builds energy, Guard blocks a normal attack, Blast spends 1 energy to attack, Energy Blast spends 3 energy and pierces Guard, and Teleport spends 2 energy to dodge any attack. If both players hit at once, it is a clash and nobody scores. A single clean hit ends a match, which usually lasts about 30 seconds. Players can fight 14 computer opponents with different play styles, play best-of-three ranked matches, or face other players online. Character customization is cosmetic only and does not affect stats.
